items.source: av_generation.seeds.seeds_digest over freeze.reference_seed_keys() (2,880 keys under A-C01 and bank-C001): changes when the derivation changes
av_generation.constants (Study A protocol section 3.3): 4 rounds x 3 slots of 40 s, 20-s rating slots, 20 min per atom, 4 atoms per 90-min booking
av_generation.constants (Study B protocol section 4): 12 slots per cell, 4 retained (3 shown + 1 reserve), 576 slots per attempt, 4 attempts
av_generation.constants A2_PITCH_STEPS, A2_CHILD_MUTATIONS and freeze.A2_RULES_TEXT, implemented by av_generation.a2 (Study A protocol section 3.5)

value.children: child k of rounds 2-4 mutates k distinct coordinates drawn uniformly without replacement
value.index_step: duration, rhythm weight, gap and amplitude move one index up or down with equal probability
value.parent: highest-scoring eligible candidate seen so far; with none, the round is sampled as round 1
value.reflection: reflect at the domain ends; a pitch reflected back to its original value takes the nearest legal inward one-semitone step (logged as corrected)
value.round_1: uniform: every coordinate drawn uniformly from its allowed values; invalid samples consume their slots (no rejection sampling)
value.stream: one PCG64 stream per slot from A2|<batch_ns>|<atom>|<round>|<slot>

items.source: av_generation.constants MIN_ACCEPTABLE_COMFORT, FIRST_ATOM_DISTINGUISHABILITY and freeze.SELECTOR_RULES_TEXT, implemented by av_generation.selector and orchestrator (Study A protocol sections 3.3, 3.7)

value.eligible: technical checks pass and at least min_acceptable_comfort raters mark comfort acceptable
value.fallback: no eligible candidate: first unused bank recipe that passes the book's checks; none passes: the whole fallback book replaces the book (failed generation, method label kept)
value.incumbent: highest score among the eligible candidates seen so far; committed after round 4
